description_en: List trace data that meets the specified conditions from trace logs
description_zh: 每条链路数据记录，可以命名为trace。一个trace包含了一组span记录。这个API以trace为粒度执行搜索，按照指定条件获取trace数据列表
name: ListTracesDatas

parameters.help_en: The list of trace IDs
parameters.help_zh: 链路id数组
parameters.name: trace_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of span IDs. Each trace record contains one or more spans
parameters.help_zh: span id数组。一条链路记录里包含一个或多个span
parameters.name: span_ids

parameters.help_en: The value of the `attributes.gen_ai.session.id` field in trace records. Default is empty
parameters.help_zh: 链路记录里attributes.gen_ai.session.id字段的值。默认为空
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The lower limit of the search time range, in UTC format (YYYY-mm-dd or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss). By default, the value is (current time - 2 days)
parameters.help_zh: 搜索时间范围下限，UTC时间，YYYY-mm-dd或者YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss格式。默认（当前时间 - 2天）
parameters.name: min_time

parameters.help_en: The upper limit of the search time range, in UTC format (YYYY-mm-dd or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss). By default, the value is (current time +10 minutes)
parameters.help_zh: 搜索时间范围上限，UTC时间，YYYY-mm-dd或者YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss格式。默认（当前时间 + 10分钟）
parameters.name: max_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Page starts from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。 起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值10，最大值50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A filter condition used when searching for traces. Returns traces that contain the specified span name.
parameters.help_zh: 查找Trace时使用的过滤条件，返回包含该span名称的Trace
parameters.name: span_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the resources.service.app.name field in the trace record. It can contain upper and lower case letters, digits, dot (.), hyphen (-), and underscore (_). Must be an exact match. It is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 链路记录里，resources.service.app.name字段的值。允许a-zA-Z0-9 dot, hyphen, underscore这些字符。必须完全匹配。默认为空
parameters.name: llm_app_name

parameters.help_en: A filter condition used when searching for traces: the minimum trace duration, in seconds (s)
parameters.help_zh: 查找Trace时使用的过滤条件，Trace的最小持续时长。单位为秒（s）
parameters.name: min_duration

parameters.help_en: A filter condition used when searching for traces: the maximum trace duration, in seconds (s)
parameters.help_zh: 查找Trace时使用的过滤条件，Trace的最大持续时长。单位为秒（s）
parameters.name: max_duration

parameters.help_en: Whether the returned JSON data can be directly converted to OpenTelemetry TracesData protobuf object. Default value: False. JSON data that is compatible with OpenTelemetry is more complex. Such data is generally not required unless you want to generate a protobuf object of OpenTelemetry
parameters.help_zh: 返回的json格式数据是否可以直接转换成opentelemetry TracesData protobuf对象。默认为False。OpenTelemetry格式兼容的json数据，格式更复杂，除非为了生成OpenTelemetry的protobuf对象，一般不需要这种格式的数据
parameters.name: opentelemetry_compatible

parameters.help_en: Whether to return only trace records containing spans with a non-empty statusMessage. Example: Suppose a trace has 3 spans. If this parameter is True, this trace meets the condition when any one of the 3 spans has a non-empty statusMessage. The default value is False. The statusMessage is not used for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回包含有statusMessage不为空的span的链路记录。比如1个链路里有3个span，如果该项为True，3个span任何1个有非空的statusMessage，那么这个链路就符合条件。默认为False，不用statusMessage状态做筛选
parameters.name: has_status_message

parameters.help_en: Whether to return only trace records containing spans with a non-empty events. Example: Suppose a trace has 3 spans. If this parameter is True, this trace meets the condition when any one of the 3 spans has a non-empty events. The default value is False. The events is not used for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回包含有events不为空的span的链路记录。比如1个链路里有3个span，如果该项为True，3个span任何1个有非空的events，那么这个链路记录就符合条件。默认为False，不用events状态做筛选
parameters.name: has_events

parameters.help_en: The value of the resources.service.owner.sub_id field in the trace record. It can contain upper and lower case letters, digits, dot (.), hyphen (-), and underscore (_). It is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 链路记录里resources.service.owner.sub_id字段的值。允许a-zA-Z0-9 dot, hyphen, underscore这些字符。默认为空
parameters.name: owner_sub_id

parameters.help_en: The value of the attributes.service.app.user_id field in the trace record. It can contain upper and lower case letters, digits, dot (.), hyphen (-), and underscore (_). It is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 链路记录里attributes.service.app.user_id字段的值。允许a-zA-Z0-9 dot, hyphen, underscore这些字符。默认为空
parameters.name: end_user_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter parameter, case-insensitive. Supported parameters: 'serviceid', 'servicename', 'input', 'output', 'status', 'tracetype', and 'tracename'.

The otel span attributes corresponding to the parameters:

serviceid: resources.service.id

servicename: resources.service.name

input: attributes.input.value

output: attributes.output.value

status: statusCode

tracetype: the attributes.gen_ai.span.kind of span whose parentSpanId is 0

tracename: the spanName of span whose parentSpanId is 0

Valid values:

Status
SpanName
Input
TraceType
SpanType
ServiceName
Output
TraceName
ServiceId
fields.help_zh:
过滤参数名称，支持若干预定义参数和用户自定义参数。

预定义参数，大小写不敏感，包括：'serviceid', 'servicename', 'input', 'output', 'status', 'tracetype', 'tracename'。这些预定义参数对应的span属性如下：

serviceid: resources.service.id

servicename: resources.service.name

input: attributes.input.value

output: attributes.output.value

status: statusCode

tracetype: parentSpanId是0的span，attributes.gen_ai.span.kind

tracename: parentSpanId是0的span，spanName

自定义参数，大小写敏感。：
用户可以自定义参数名称。这个名称会作为一个以attributes开头的json路径的后缀。服务端以这个json路径为位置，按operator和value，筛选符合条件的span。

比如用户自定义key为 foo.bar，那么服务端会在attributes.foo.bar 这个位置执行筛选。比如用户自定义key为 gen_ai.FOO.BAR，那么服务端会在attributes.gen_ai.FOO.BAR 这个位置执行筛选
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The parameter operator. Case-insensitive. Supported operators: '=', 'contains', and 'startswith'.

Valid values:

contains
\=
startsWith
fields.help_zh: 参数运算符。大小写不敏感。目前支持：‘=’，’contains‘，'startswith'
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en: The value of the filter parameter. For the contains operation, it is case-sensitive. For other operations, it is case-insensitive
fields.help_zh: 过滤参数取值。对于contains操作，大小写敏感。其它操作，大小写不敏感
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Other filter parameters
parameters.help_zh: 额外的过滤参数
parameters.name: filters

parameters.help_en:
The content simplification method for returned trace data to reduce the data volume.

REMOVE_EMBEDDING: Removes all embedding array contents.

ROOT_ONLY: Returns only the root span for each trace, with the root span content also having the REMOVE_EMBEDDING applied.

Blank: Maintains the original data without simplification
parameters.help_zh:
对返回的链路数据做内容简化的方法，用于减少数据返回量。

REMOVE_EMBEDDING - 将所有的embedding数组具体内容清除

ROOT_ONLY - 每个链路仅返回root span，且如果root span内容也做REMOVE_EMBEDDING处理。

不填写 - 则维持原有数据
parameters.name: trace_reduce_method

parameters.help_en: The field used to sort the returned results. Valid values: StartTime and Duration
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果排序字段，目前支持trace开始时间、trace时长、trace总token数量、和trace id
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

ASC
DESC (default)
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
ASC：升序
DESC（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

Code.description_en: The internal error code. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of traces that meet the condition

Traces.description_en: The JSON array with each element being a trace's JSON string. Length of the array is equal to or less than the page size parameter value
Traces.description_zh: json array，每个element是一个trace的json string。array长度等于或者小于page size参数值
